propositions: Five modules independently derive sidecar directory paths (`.rebar` location) with inconsistent symlink resolution, causing repeated bugs when the logic is copied
Multiple modules parse `.git` gitfiles separately to compute git directory and git common directory, duplicating logic across `push_state.py` and `sync.py`
A single frozen `StorePaths(tracker)` class should centralize all tracker-relative path derivations, exposing `canonical`, `git_dir`, `git_common_dir`, `rebar_dir`, and sidecar/log methods

A guard test should enforce that no module outside `paths.py` computes `dirname(tracker)/.rebar` joins for sidecars, using token scanning and escape markers to prevent re-introduction of the duplication
Symlinked worktree trackers must resolve all sidecar paths to the same canonical store location, verified by end-to-end test
